summary: Master sales forecasting and pipeline analytics with CRM-based methods, forecast dashboards, and practical exercises. Enrol to improve revenue accuracy.
lede: Sales forecasting and pipeline analytics uses opportunity, stage and conversion data to estimate revenue and assess pipeline health. The course is for sales operations professionals, revenue analysts and managers who prepare forecasts or review CRM pipelines. It covers weighted forecasts, stage-conversion and variance analysis, pipeline segmentation, scenario planning, and reporting risks and corrective actions for forecast reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with pipeline data, revenue planning, CRM reporting, and forecast reviews. You will get the most value if you already support commercial execution or leadership reporting and need a more disciplined way to analyse sales performance.
modules: Sales Forecasting Foundations and Pipeline Discipline
Pipeline Data Quality and Forecast Diagnostics
Forecast Models with CRM and Time-Series Methods
Executive Reporting and Revenue Action Plans
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample or exported CRM data if available. Before attending, review your team’s pipeline stages, close-date conventions, and last forecast cycle so you can apply the exercises to a real commercial context. The course assumes intermediate familiarity with sales reporting, not advanced statistical programming.
